text:
Tage Thompson's goals keep landing at the moments that matter. By our wins-added count, which weighs each goal by how much it moved the win probability, he's second among 522 skaters. His latest came 33 seconds into the third period in Tampa, a rocket that briefly made it 4-3 before the Lightning ran away with it. He has 12 goals in 19 games, the latest against Chicago on Thursday.

The goals are mostly earned. He's shooting 16% against 15% last season, with 12 goals on 8.7 expected, and Buffalo has scored 5.4 more goals than expected with him on. That's a mild cool-down coming, not a collapse.

The team around him is the tougher story. Buffalo has lost four of its last five he's played in, and after the loss in Tampa he called out what Heavy.com described as a troubling pattern. At five on five the Sabres are roughly even in expected goals with him on. Evolving-Hockey had him facing 93rd-percentile competition last season, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 93rd percentile for chances from the slot. He's doing his part. Buffalo needs more of it from everyone else.
headline: Thompson's goals are swinging games
